title: Pricing table
description: The dated price list bin/cost.py prices a call from (F2c B). A row is one model of one connection from one date: per_million is the price of a million tokens of each of the five token types, batch_discount the fraction taken off a batch call. The newest row whose effective_from is not after the call's time applies; a model with no row is unpriced (never a guess). A price is the provider's published price with its source; the weekly model check refreshes the file. An empty list is valid.

model.description: A model id of that connection (cost.py check judges the pair).

effective_from.description: UTC date, or date and time ending in Z: compared as text with a call's ts.

source.description: Where the price was read (a page, a date).

reasoning.description: Reasoning tokens are counted apart from output tokens; a provider that bills them as output has the output price here.

batch_discount.description: The fraction taken off a batch call's amount (0.5 = half price, 0 = no discount).
